embedding: corrected DINOv2 fixed 32-D projection inside 48-D causal observation
assignment: one NEW dummy plus existing causal track candidates; masked cross-entropy
sampling: one positive existing assignment per one NEW/keep example in fit batches; natural validation
inference: argmax over NEW and candidate logits; collision-safe canonical remap; preserve every Q0 row
checkpoint_selection: validation non-NEW precision, recall, then assignment accuracy; pred_non_new must be nonzero
q0_anchor: all boxes/scores/non-assigned proposal rows preserved; only physical lineage association may change
train_labels: TRAIN GT IoU-matched track target only; labels never serialized in inference tensors
